model_hint_distil_large_v3_5: Fast distilled large-v3.5; near-large-v3 accuracy at about 6x speed. Strong for English; good for 6GB+ GPUs.
model_hint_tiny: Fastest option for quick tests and very old hardware.
model_hint_base: Good CPU default for everyday dictation.
model_hint_small: Balanced accuracy and speed for most laptops and entry GPUs.
model_hint_medium: High accuracy; needs 6GB+ VRAM or a strong CPU.
model_hint_large_v3_turbo: Newest official Whisper; about 8x faster than large-v3 with similar accuracy.
model_hint_distil_large_v3: Fast distilled large-v3; strong on English; good for 6GB+ GPUs.
model_hint_kotoba: Japanese-optimized Whisper; more accurate than large-v3 on Japanese at half the size. For best results, choose Japanese as the transcription language.
